meta.definition: Historical planning network developed by Philadelphia OTIS from 2019-2023 crash data to guide traffic safety investments; not a live condition or route certification.
meta.method: ArcGIS GeoJSON ordered by objectid; rows encode [snapshotObjectId, streetName, lengthFt, shapeLength, geometryType, coordinates]; coordinates rounded to 6 decimals.
